details: This package runs its main script from a preinstall hook, so simply installing it immediately issues an outbound HTTPS GET to a third-party host before any application code runs. The hook executes index.js, which requests hxxps://realwbx[.]com/ip.php?ip=8[.]8[.]8[.]8 with a hardcoded Authorization header token and logs the response. The request originates from the installing machine, disclosing the installer's network address to realwbx[.]com. The script performs no other action: it does not read environment variables, credentials,.npmrc, or any files, does not spawn processes, and does not download or execute a second-stage payload. The package is a three-file stub (index.js, package.json, README.md) whose only behaviour is this install-time callback.
